static_traits.name: Li Shan
static_traits.social_status: relationships with colleagues have become tense due to Persistent self-criticism after mistakes; has a few close friends to confide in, but has not yet shared this specific issue with them
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness; without treatment or counseling experience for prior psychological issues; has not yet experienced similar psychological distress before
static_traits.language_features: expression clear, relatively strong logic, able to identify and describe her own thought patterns; high level of cooperation; mood slightly shows Anxiety; tends toward self-critical and all-or-nothing language

basic_info.main_problem: I especially struggle with feelings of failure and inability in terms of baking skill.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize negative self-perception is affecting my enjoyment of baking, and I want to resolve it before the problem escalates further.

special_situations.event: Baked 15 batches of cookies in one evening for a charity sale, one batch slightly burnt
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: as long as any mistake occurs, it means I am incompetent/a failure; I must always be perfect at baking to be considered qualified
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles practice and seeks others' approval, over-focuses on and picks out errors to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I actually messed this up too; I am a failure at baking

special_situations.event: failed while developing a new dessert for a special event, did not present as planned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: must present perfectly on important occasions, otherwise it proves my overall ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterwards repeatedly replays and reproaches oneself, reduces trying new things to lower the chance of failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough, I am not fit to be a Chef

special_situations.event: when making croissants last week, the dough had not yet risen properly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: as long as I fail once, it means I am completely no good
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: seek validation from colleagues for brief comfort, while engaging in Self-denial to 'urge' improvement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: failed again, all my skills are not trustworthy

special_situations.event: when thinking about whether to tell close friends about this distress, have a premonition they will not understand
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if others cannot fully understand my mistakes and feelings, they will negate me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing concrete problems with friends, reducing external feedback to protect self-esteem

core_conflict.wish: long to be recognized and accepted, especially as an excellent Baker
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being belittled or rejected by others after failure, worried about losing my sense of worth
defense_goal: prevent mistakes through strict Self-monitoring and self-criticism, to maintain a sense of control and being recognized

object_relations.self_representation: not good enough, a self that could fail at any time
object_relations.object_representation: harsh, others ready to judge and negate at any time (colleagues/customers/the public)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when baking mistakes occur or things are not perfect, or when Anticipating that others will notice the mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: others will look down on me, I must 'punish' myself to prove I am correcting it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use a self-blaming and self-deprecating tone (such as 'I am just no good'), deflect others' comfort, emphasize mistake details to prove I am at fault.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing or recalling failure details, emotions run high but I need to continue working/communicating
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I invest emotion I will lose control, so I need to control the situation with pure technique and standards
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: list steps and standards in calm, technical language, avoid emotional vocabulary; use 'should/must' sentence patterns, reduce emotional expression.

manifestations: Negative self-cognition makes baking joyless, the process dominated by mistakes and perfection standards
frequently equate failure with lowered self-worth, experientially inconsistent with the self

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: excessively self-criticize and label after mistakes (such as 'I am a failure')
Carefully avoids sharing true troubles with friends
Defines self and work standards with 'should/must'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: believe friends 'will not understand me', preset others' negative view of the self
in relationships with colleagues, Anticipate that others will judge harshly, and thus become tense and defensive

positive_force: have professional baking training and skill foundation (Culinary school graduate)
willing to seek help and work with the counselor, able to identify and name negative thought patterns
Has a potential support network of a few close friends
negative_force: Perfectionism and external pressure leading to equating mistakes with overall failure
Relies on external recognition to maintain self-worth (seeks validation but the effect is brief)
all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization and mental filtering, persistently ignore the positive
Self-labeling and self-criticism tendencies, harming mood and relationships

target_behavior.behavior: excessive self-criticism and negative self-labels (such as 'I am a failure')
antecedent: when baking mistakes occur or things are not perfect enough
When facing an important event or high-standard pressure
target_behavior.core_reason: in high-pressure perfection-seeking situations, generalize one or a few mistakes into overall ability being insufficient, and evaluate the self through an all-or-nothing framework
target_behavior.function: Gaining a short-term sense of control and a feeling of 'self-correction' through self-blame, while avoiding facing external evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood,Decline in work performance,Tense relationships with colleagues,Reduced enjoyment of baking

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids trying new recipes or challenging tasks
antecedent: When experiencing failure recently or Anticipation of possible failure
Facing high-risk or high-exposure baking tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of being negated by others after failure, viewing one mistake as a total negation of ability
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential failure and negative evaluation, maintains short-term sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Creativity and professional growth limited,Decreased motivation,Work satisfaction reduced

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeking external validation to ease Self-doubt
antecedent: After feeling uncertain or making small mistakes during baking tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth highly depends on others' approval, lacking stability in self-evaluation
target_behavior.function: Gaining comfort and recognition in the short term to reduce Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Develops dependence on external feedback, finding it hard to build inner confidence and stable self-evaluation
